newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&P 500 futures rally to new record high.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&P 500 futures rally to new record high.

text.p: June 10 - U.S. stock index rose. June S&P 500 futures briefly rallied to a new all-time high at 872.30. The contract leapt above psychological resistance at 870.00. NASDAQ stocks erased early losses and firmed, T-bond futures edged back up toward peaks. Santa Fe Int'l shares jumped more than expected after largest IPO yet this year. Fair value about 1.05 pts over.
